'''Walker''' (Japanese: '''イクオ''' ''Ikuo'') is a recurring character in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''. He is a system engineer at Gogo Systems, the father of [[Goh]], the husband of [[Camille]], and the son-in-law of [[Halta]].

==History==
Walker first appeared in ''[[JN015|A Snow Day for Searching!]]''. He was working alongside his wife when they received a phone call from Goh, who informed them that he was coming back home to visit them. After wondering why Goh was visiting them, Walker and Camille finished their work before going to meet Goh. Just then, they received a call for help, forcing them to inform Goh that they will be on late.

Once their work was done, Walker and Camille were heading home when they spotted Goh riding {{AP|Dragonite}}. They approached Goh after {{TP|Goh|Dewgong}} retrieved a {{TP|Goh|Cubone}}'s bone and were introduced to {{Ash}}. After meeting Goh's Pokémon and witnessing Goh {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} Cubone, the group headed home to enjoy some stew, where they found that [[Halta]] had won her karaoke tournament.

Walker reappeared in ''[[JN032|Time After Time!]]'', where he, Camille, and Goh went on a family holiday trip to a cottage in [[Azalea Town]], which they had also done three years earlier.

Walker reappeared in ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', when he joined a party taking place at [[Cerise Laboratory]].
